Selected work
Workflow automation

Every meeting becomes tasks and follow-ups, automatically.

Any recording in English, standard Arabic or Egyptian dialect becomes decisions, action items, tasks and a personalised follow-up email to each participant.

  • Groq Whisper large-v3
  • GPT-4o-mini via OpenRouter
  • Notion
  • Telegram
  • Gmail
<$0.05 Per meeting, end to end Where this number comes from

The problem

The decisions in a meeting are worth something; the notes almost never get written. Whoever was going to write them was also in the meeting, and by the time the day ends the specifics are gone. The follow-up that would have made the meeting matter does not get sent.

What it does

01

Takes the recording as it is

English, Modern Standard Arabic or Egyptian dialect, no separate setup per language, no asking people to speak differently.

02

Pulls out the parts that matter

A summary, the decisions taken, the open questions, and action items with an owner and a deadline attached rather than a flat list of bullets.

03

Puts the work where the work lives

Tasks are created and linked, a searchable record of the meeting is filed, and every participant gets a personalised email with only their own to-dos, in the language of the meeting.

How it is built

RecordingTranscribeExtractCreate tasksNotify

Transcription on a fast hosted Whisper, extraction on a small, cheap model with structured output so the result is parseable rather than prose, then deterministic workflows to create the records and send the mail. The organiser gets one notification when it is done.

What I'd watch if it were yours

Per-unit cost is a design constraint

An automation that costs more per run than the work it replaces is not automation, it is a subscription. This one was designed to the unit cost from the first sketch.

Structured output, not prose

Asking for a paragraph and parsing it back is where these pipelines break. Ask for the shape you need.

Send each person only their own items

A shared summary gets skimmed. A three-line email addressed to one person gets acted on.

Under $0.05 per meeting end to end, across transcription and extraction. For a 30-minute English meeting that is roughly two cents of speech-to-text and a fraction of a cent of extraction.
